evidence.note: The pinned /DomainInfo/domains_data responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/properties/result/properties/data oneOf references HashOutput and ListOutput. ListOutput omits the array container, whereas parameter format=list and examples/list/value/data explicitly contain a list. HashOutput main_domain describes items while examples/hash/value/data/addon_domains/2/main_domain is an object. The effective contract retains both documented containers and the explicit example object. Components Contents and MainDomainContents supply optional row fields; list examples additionally supply options, numeric-string port, string flags, customlog/scriptalias lists, and separate parked redirect name lists. Parked domain names also occur as strings in the hash example. These are pinned documentation discrepancies, not live observations.

One-off read-only name inspection on 2026-11-01 from revision 760ca68: one direct UAPI GET as npr printed only key names and structural types, never values. The format=hash main_domain object carried phpopenbasedirprotect as a numeric string, and phpversion and status as non-numeric strings. None is declared by the pinned domains_data schema or its examples. All three are optional mixed and deliberately unvalidated, because a value outside a declared type must not fail the whole read. phpversion and status have no pinned meaning, so claiming a type from one observation would invent a contract. phpopenbasedirprotect has a pinned 0/1 meaning on single_domain_data and WHM domainuserdata, but domains_data does not promise it, and the sibling forms do not bound it: single_domain_data accepts 0, 1, "0" and "1", userdirprotect adds only the empty string, and pinned WHM domainuserdata documents userdirprotect as On or Off. A flag would still fail on null, 2, booleans or such strings. mixed keeps the value as sent, so a quoted form is not normalized here as it is in singleDomainData(). Addon, parked and subdomain rows were empty and format=list was not requested, so those records are unchanged.

notes.text: Returns a hash of domain-type containers or a list according to format. User-data files can omit any documented field. Explicit null IPv6 remains null. Pinned prose/schema and examples disagree on several containers; the effective shape preserves the documented hash/list variants and example log/alias lists.

Quoted 0/1 domain flags and port values normalize to integers. The documented empty-string userdirprotect value stays an empty string, distinct from 0; other nonflag strings remain invalid. Shared flag fields use the same wire compatibility across record kinds and singleDomainData().

On cPanel 11.138.0.19 the format=hash main_domain object, one record through both direct and bridged UAPI, also carries phpopenbasedirprotect as a numeric string and phpversion and status as non-numeric strings. Addon, parked, subdomain and format=list records were not observed with these fields and keep their documented shape.

main_domain phpopenbasedirprotect, phpversion and status are optional and deliberately unvalidated: any JSON value, including null, reaches the caller unchanged and cannot fail the read. phpversion and status have unknown meaning. phpopenbasedirprotect is documented on singleDomainData() but not promised by domains_data, so a quoted value stays a string here and is not normalized to an integer.

notes.text: Only query an account-owned main, addon or subdomain; aliases have no user-data file and must be queried through their associated main or addon domain. Any documented result field may be omitted.

The pinned parameter name is return_https_redirect_status (singular redirect); some return descriptions incorrectly use return_https_redirects_status. The request uses the declared singular parameter. Hiding a requested temporary domain causes an API error.

Observed customlog and scriptalias may be lists as well as the pinned objects. Quoted 0/1 hascgi and phpopenbasedirprotect flags normalize to integers, as do lossless integer port strings. Unknown fields remain outside the contract.

Shared domain flags accept the quoted 0/1 forms documented by the domains_data examples. The userdirprotect empty-string variant is preserved without mapping it to 0; other nonflag strings remain invalid. Optional fields remain omitted when absent.

On cPanel 11.138.0.19 the result for one account main domain, through both direct and bridged UAPI, also carries phpversion and status as non-numeric strings. customlog list items carry format; the pinned domain key was absent from them. format is typed for list items only.

phpversion and status are optional and deliberately unvalidated because their meaning is unknown: any JSON value, including null, reaches the caller unchanged and cannot fail the read. Only an account main domain was observed, so nothing is claimed for other domain kinds.
